```{r setup, include=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(JBrowseR)
library(htmltools)


assembly <- assembly(
    "GenomeFiles/expandedgenomeregions.fa",
    bgzip = FALSE
  )

track_data <- track_feature(
  "GenomeFiles/minimaptrial.bed.gz",
  assembly,
)


tracks <- tracks(track_data)


```

```{r}
JBrowseR("View", assembly = assembly, tracks = tracks)

```
